itemDisplayName: Azure AI Gateway with optional Azure OpenAI routing
description: Deploy an Azure AI Gateway with a system-assigned managed identity and a runtime API key. Optionally connect existing Azure OpenAI deployments through a weighted model alias with a token limit, and export telemetry to Application Insights without capturing payloads.
summary: Deploy Azure AI Gateway with optional managed-identity Azure OpenAI routing, a weighted model alias, token limits, and Application Insights.
